name: 대명사 사용 패턴
description: 분석합니다 대명사 분포 (personal, demonstrative, relative) 감지하기 위해 AI 생성 text's distinctive 대명사 avoidance 패턴.
useCase: Detecting AI text through systematic differences in 대명사 usage frequency and variety
mechanism: Categorizes and quantifies 대명사 usage 에 걸친 subcategories: first-person (I, we, me), second-person (you, your), third-person (he, she, they), demonstrative (this, that, these), and relative (는, that, who). AI 생성 text typically underuses first-person 대명사s, overuses impersonal constructions ('it is', 'one can'), and shows less pronominal variety. The method computes 대명사 density, category ratios, and positional 패턴.
accuracy: 중간 - 70-80% on opinion and narrative text
source: Pennebaker, J. W. (2011) - The Secret Life of Pronouns: What Our Words Say About Us, Bloomsbury Press
algorithm: Pronoun Categorization + Density Analysis + Category Ratio Comparison + Positional Mapping
parameters: Categories: PRP/PRP$/WP/DT, Density: per 100 words, Ratios: 1st/3rd person, self-reference index, Normalization: genre-adjusted
strengths:
• 대명사는 강한 심리적 및 문체적 신호를 전달
• 추출 및 분석이 용이
• 개인 및 의견 텍스트에 효과적
• 광범위한 심리언어학 연구에 뒷받침됨
limitations:
• Less useful for technical or instructional text
• Cultural and genre differences affect baseline
• AI can be prompted to use specific 대명사 패턴
• Needs genre-specific reference 분포s
